rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.math.definition.selection against rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:select, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:extract_declaration, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:has_named_definition_body, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:definition_source, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:definition_blocks_select_multiple_complete_declarations_and_preserve_markdown, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:definition_blocks_reject_missing_wrong_kind_and_malformed_citations, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::definitions_select_complete_equations_structure_literals_and_multiline_bodies, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::definition_selection_ignores_comment_and_literal_decoys, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::definitions_reject_unsupported_incomplete_and_ambiguous_sources. select routes definitions to exact named extraction, which admits def/abbrev/structure/inductive and rejects wrong kinds, modifiers, attributes, ambiguous or incomplete forms.
